title: Eating With IBS: A UK Guide to Diet, FODMAPs and Fibre
excerpt: Nearly one in five UK adults live with IBS. Here's what the evidence actually says about diet, fibre types and the low FODMAP approach.
author: Bite Insight Team
meta_title: Eating With IBS: A UK Guide to Diet, FODMAPs and Fibre
meta_description: IBS affects almost one in five UK adults. This guide explains what the evidence says about diet, fibre types, FODMAPs and everyday food triggers.
ai_summary: IBS affects almost one in five UK adults and shows up in three patterns: constipation type, diarrhoea type and mixed type. This guide explains why generic fibre advice can backfire, how the low FODMAP diet works when done properly with a dietitian, and which everyday foods and habits tend to trigger symptoms. It also covers the red flag symptoms that mean a trip to the GP rather than a diet change.
